title: PROBLEMS IN CRIME AND JUSTICE
description: Analyzes contemporary issues in crime and justice, with a focus on U.S. society. Explores the causes and consequences of major problems and issues in crime and justice including gang activity, terrorism, white collar and environmental crime, gun attitudes and violence, challenges associated with policing, drug use, and mass incarceration.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
